We need to find a retrosynthetic template that when applied to the given molecule (target) yields precursors (mapped_rxn). The description: cycloaddition reaction, two unsaturated molecules combine to form a cyclic product. In forward reaction, carbon-carbon bond formed, carbon-oxygen broken. Functional groups lost: ketones and C-C triple bonds. So retrosynthesis: break a C-C bond (new sigma) and form a C-O bond? Actually forward: C-C formed, C-O broken, losing ketone and alkyne. So retrosynthetic step: break a C-C bond (the one formed) and form a C-O bond, generating a ketone and alkyne fragments.

We need to search template catalog with criteria: functional_groups_broken includes "ketone"? Actually forward reaction loses ketone, so ketone is broken (i.e., functional group broken). Also loses C-C triple bond (alkyne) broken. Bonds formed: C-C (single). Bonds broken: C-O (single). Also bond order changed? maybe C=O to C-O? but we can specify.

Let's call search_template_catalog_by_criteria with molecule SMILES: COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O

We need functional_groups_broken: ["ketone", "alkyne"] maybe names. Need to know available functional groups list. Use get_available_functional_groups.

We need to call get_available_functional_groups.
